create_GoogleDocAIPredictionProvider: create a GoogleDocAIPredictionProvider instance to call Google Document AI API for document prediction
run_predict: run the predict method on a DatasetRecord to generate a DoclingDocument prediction from Google Document AI
convert_google_output_to_docling: convert Google Document AI JSON output to a DoclingDocument with text blocks and table structures
process_table_row: process a table row from Google Document AI output and add TableCell objects to a TableData structure
get_info: get the asset name and google-cloud-documentai library version from the prediction provider
